scenes.title: Proposal in the Cafe
scenes.summary: In this flashback to the nineteen-nineties, young Ivan Samsonov takes Nina to a crowded local cafe.

scenes.title: Samson Waits for an Answer
scenes.summary: In this continuation of the nineteen-nineties flashback, Nina walks out of the cafe, expecting Samsonov to leave for his soccer match.

scenes.title: Nina Says Yes
scenes.summary: In this concluding scene of the nineteen-nineties flashback, Samson continues to wait patiently for Nina.

scenes.title: How Much Money Does It Take
scenes.summary: In our last scene, Nina finally accepted young Ivan's proposal outside the registry office.

scenes.title: Ilona's Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Back in Sineozersk, Samsonov and Arkady are in the communal flat examining painful social media photos of Nina vacationing with her new lover.

scenes.title: The President's Visit
scenes.summary: A moment later, acting mayor Pavel Yuryevich hears alarming political news from his campaign aide.

scenes.title: Panic at Headquarters
scenes.summary: Right after that, Pavel Yuryevich erupts in anger at his campaign headquarters.

scenes.title: Preparing for the Meeting
scenes.summary: Meanwhile, Arkady exults over the upcoming presidential visit with Samsonov in the communal kitchen.

scenes.title: Nina's Anxiety
scenes.summary: Back in Sineozersk, Nina sits nervously with Daniil, unable to calm down.

scenes.title: Major Lavrov's Report
scenes.summary: A moment later, a tense confrontation erupts between Major Lavrov and General Georgiy Borisovich.

scenes.title: Breakfast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the quiet morning, Lev Yegorych prepares a homemade breakfast for Vika in her kitchen.

scenes.title: A Couple More
scenes.summary: Vika worries about gaining weight from eating so much, but Lev reassures her that genuine affection is not about physical appearances.

scenes.title: Call Me Vika
scenes.summary: Having invited Lev to use her informal first name, Vika expresses how relieved she feels in his company.

scenes.title: Diversification
scenes.summary: In the hallway, Ivan Samsonov is frantically pacing and trying to memorize complex economic vocabulary.

scenes.title: Meeting with the President
scenes.summary: In the communal flat, Ivan Samsonov tries to hide his heartbreak after his family left him.

scenes.title: A Call to Pavel
scenes.summary: Still under house arrest, Arkady calls his treacherous deputy Pavel at the mayor's office.

scenes.title: Checking the Schedule
scenes.summary: Worried by Ivan's wild claims about an upcoming presidential audience, Nina calls Samsonov's campaign manager Ilona to check his official calendar.

scenes.title: A Visit with Lyolya
scenes.summary: Still under house arrest in the communal apartment, Arkady brings Lyolya to Marina's room to break up with her in dramatic fashion.

scenes.title: Testing Before the Meeting
scenes.summary: Special medical inspectors arrive to take health tests from Ivan Samsonov before his presidential meeting.

scenes.title: Report of Resignation
scenes.summary: Packing up their surveillance equipment in the office, Sokolov and Tolya reflect on their ruined careers.

scenes.title: Anikeev's Freedom
scenes.summary: With the court decision overturning his house arrest, Arkady Anikeev receives back his foreign passport and valuables.

scenes.title: Before Departure
scenes.summary: Standing at the threshold of his apartment, Arkady gives last-minute instructions to his security detail.

scenes.title: An Offer to Leave
scenes.summary: Before fleeing abroad, Arkady pays a surprise visit to Marina's room.

scenes.title: In the Admitting Ward
scenes.summary: An agitated Ivan Samsonov is escorted into the admitting ward of the psychiatric clinic.

scenes.title: The Calming Medicine
scenes.summary: In the psychiatric hospital's medical room, the doctor and orderly prepare a sedative for their unruly patient.

scenes.title: Visit to the Clinic
scenes.summary: Pavel arrives at the psychiatric hospital to collect mayoral candidate Ivan Samsonov for his meeting with the President.

scenes.title: Inner Resilience
scenes.summary: Hyped up on experimental stimulants before his meeting with the president, Ivan Samsonov marches into the room with intense energy.

scenes.title: Managing the Staff
scenes.summary: Arriving at the secret location where his bribe money was concealed, Arkady Borisovich is greeted by former secretary Lidia Alexeyevna.

scenes.title: A Simple Setup
scenes.summary: Just as Arkady prepares to flee with the bags of cash, his former deputy Pasha intercepts him.

scenes.title: Fate Gave Change Back
scenes.summary: Defeated, empty-handed, and escorted back to the communal flat, Arkady steps into the corridor.

scenes.title: The Ankle Monitor
scenes.summary: Arkady is fitted with an electronic ankle bracelet as he returns to house arrest in the apartment.

scenes.title: Arkady's Breakdown
scenes.summary: Klavdiya Viktorovna mocks Arkady upon his return until he unexpectedly breaks down in tears.

scenes.title: Eduard Looks for Marina
scenes.summary: Drunk and heartbroken, Eduard arrives at the communal apartment looking for Marina, only to find she is with Arkady.

scenes.title: Showdown in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Samsonov furiously confronts Nina and Danya, triggering a fierce quarrel in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Candidate's Fight
scenes.summary: Outside on the street, Ivan Samsonov gets into a heated physical fight.

scenes.title: Jedis and Samsonov
scenes.summary: Ivan Samsonov returns to his communal apartment room after the street brawl, where his wife Nina and daughter Yulia attend to him while watching breaking news of his political campaign on television.

scenes.title: Understood, Major
scenes.summary: Inside the surveillance van, operative Sokolov reports the latest wiretap findings to the general over the telephone line, while Major Lavrov's career hangs by a single thread.

scenes.title: Colleagues Again
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov and agent Sokolov celebrate being colleagues again after the general tears up Sokolov's report.

scenes.title: Lev Egorych
scenes.summary: In his private residence, Governor Lev Yegorych relaxes with young Vika, who playfully flatters him while he encourages her to drop formal titles and address him simply by his first name.

scenes.title: How Much Money Does It Take
scenes.summary: As the eleventh episode concludes, singer-songwriter Semyon Slepakov performs his satirical ballad about the insatiable desire for wealth, luxury, and spiritual insurance in provincial politics.
